# Backoffice 1.0.11

> **The paired web deploy is live.** `isClientSelectable`, the client-eligible
> group filter, the admin KYC upload endpoint, the balance-curve range and the
> ISO country validation are all on production, and the
> `20260921180000_group_client_selectable` migration is applied. This build can
> be installed as soon as it is published.

**Clients — the add-account form**
- The group list now shows only the groups a broker has **published to clients**. Previously it listed every group, including the **Dealer Coverage** hedge book and the **Reverse Trading** source group — an account opened in the latter is mirrored into the broker's own master account.
- The pre-selected group is the broker's **default**, not whichever sorted first.
- **Country** is a type-to-search picker over the full ISO list instead of a free-text box hinted "ISO code". It matches on name or code, and stores the code.
- **Opening balance** appears only for a **DEMO** account. It used to be shown for LIVE and then silently dropped on submit, so a typed amount was accepted on screen and the account arrived empty. A live account is funded by a deposit.
- Optional **KYC document upload** on create, for a client the broker onboards in person. It goes to the same place the KYC review screen already reads, and a failed upload says so rather than reporting success.

**Clients — the screen**
- The **ACT** column reads **OPEN**; it opens Client 360, which is what the row always did.
- Returning to CLIENTS shows the **list**, not whoever was open last. The small "← LIST" button is now a **CLIENTS** breadcrumb.
- The **balance curve** has **7D / 30D / 90D / 1Y** ranges, and when it cannot load it now says why. A failed fetch used to render the same "unavailable" as an account with no history.

**Right-click menus**
- Right-clicking the **empty area** of any table opens that table's own actions — **add account, group, account type, partner, LP, routing rule, mirror rule, lead**, and **invite a team member**. Previously these existed only as the `+` button in the panel header.
- Row menus and the header's column picker are unchanged.

**Status colours**
- **CLOSED** is now grey rather than red. Red is for refused, failed or stopped; a closed account or deal is an ordinary finished state. Deals already drew it grey, so the same word had two colours depending on the screen.
- **Trade mode** is a badge instead of tinted text on **Symbols** and **Trading halt**: `BUY ONLY` / `SELL ONLY` read amber, `BOTH` neutral. On Symbols the amber "unsaved edit" tint is kept separately, so the two meanings no longer share one colour.

**Wording**
- Column headers are spelled out instead of abbreviated: **Profit / Loss**, **Commission / Lot**, **Swap Long** / **Swap Short**, **Maximum Exposure**, **Introducing Broker**, **Liquidity Provider**, **Current Price**, **Actions**, **Margin Call Level %**, and the rest. Tables are wider as a result; one that no longer fits scrolls sideways rather than cutting a column off.
- Two different things were both labelled **Mode**. They are now **Account Mode** (live/demo), **Trading Mode** (both / buy only / sell only) and, on Groups, **Accepts Mode**.
- **State** is **Status** everywhere, matching the other nineteen columns that already said so.
- Smaller corrections: **Caps** to **Limits**, **#** to **Priority** on routing rules, **A %** to **A-Book %**, **Lot** to **Lots**, **Acct Req** to **Account Requests**.
- Three table bugs were fixed along the way, all of which affected wide tables: the header row did not follow the body when a table scrolled sideways, so headers ended up over the wrong columns; header widths ignored letter spacing and came out slightly too narrow; and a column width saved from an earlier version was never re-measured, which would have left **existing installs with permanently truncated headers** after this upgrade.
**Groups — a shorter table**
- The list is seven columns: **Name, Routing, Pricing, Dealer, Trading, Default, Status**. Accepts mode, leverage, margin call %, stop out %, maximum lot and swap-free were configuration you read once while setting a group up, never compared across rows, so they moved into the edit form — where they already were. Nothing became uneditable.
- **Trading** now works. It offered *Normal / Close-only / Disabled*, none of which the server accepts — it takes **Both sides / Buy only / Sell only** and silently turned anything else into *Both sides*. A broker could set a group to close-only, see it accepted, and the group would keep trading both ways. The column could only ever read "Normal" for the same reason.
- **Halt trading** and **Resume trading** are on the row menu. The Status column showed whether a group was halted but you had to go to Security · Emergency to act on it.

**The shell opens on the Dashboard**
- It used to open with the Dashboard highlighted in the sidebar and **no screen rendered at all** — the code lit the nav item without ever switching to the screen. It also no longer reopens on whichever screen you last closed on.


---

**Not in this build**

- **Liquidity** and **Plugins** are 1.0.12.
- **Account types (ATY)** is still unchanged — see the 1.0.10 notes.

Assets.NotesMarkdown:
# Backoffice 1.0.10

> **Requires the paired web deploy.** The Groups and Dashboard screens read
> fields (`category`, `modeRestriction`, `groupCategory`, `symbolConfigCount`)
> that only exist once the Stage 4 web commits are live, and the Symbols screen
> stops sending `defaultBookType`, which the current production route still
> rejects as missing. Pack after the web is deployed, not before.

**Groups — routing and mode are separate things**
- **ROUTING** replaces the old **BOOK** column: **A-BOOK · LP**, **B-BOOK**, **DEALING DESK**, plus **REVERSAL** and **COVERAGE · SYS** where a group already has one.
- The routing dropdown offers only the three a broker sets by hand. A group already on REVERSAL (the plugin sets it) or COVERAGE (the system owns it) keeps its value and shows it as *(set elsewhere)*, so opening the form and pressing SAVE can no longer silently re-route it.
- New **MODE** column and **Accepts** field: **LIVE + DEMO**, **LIVE ONLY**, **DEMO ONLY**. Mode was never routing; **DEMO** is gone from the routing choices.
- New **PRICING** column: **Source**, or **Custom (N symbols)**. Editing stays per symbol in panel 2.
- The **Dealer** choices say what they do: **DESK-CONTROLLED (queues when the desk is on)**, **NEVER QUEUE (ignores the desk)**, **ALWAYS QUEUE**. The panel header shows the broker's live desk state, because that switch — not the group — decides whether a DESK-CONTROLLED group queues.
- The dead **Tier** field is gone. The group is the tier.
- Deleting a group that still holds accounts answers **409 · move its accounts first** instead of failing as a server error.

**Dashboard — a client's book comes from their group**
- **BOOK** (declared but always blank) is now **CATEGORY**, filled from the account's group — the only thing that decides where an order books.
- New **GROUP** column beside it.
- **ACT** said *VIEW FUNDS* or *VIEW BLOCKED*; the row opens Client 360 and never touched funds. It is one verb, **OPEN**, and status moved to its own **STATE** tag (**SUSP**, **CLSD**), blank for an ordinary active account.
- **ALL STAFF** over the activity feed was a chip that looked like a filter and did nothing. Plain text.
- The approvals queue said *no pending withdrawals* on a panel that holds deposits too: **no pending deposits or withdrawals**.
- **LP fill quality** reads **PENDING · NEEDS LP BRIDGE** instead of a measured-looking figure. Nothing has ever been LP-executed.
- Column headers shortened (**CC**, **LOTS**, **MGN%**) and KYC shown as **OK / WAIT / FLAG** so the whole table fits at 1366 without clipping.

**Symbols — DEFAULT BOOK removed**
- The **DEFAULT BOOK** column and its click-to-cycle A/B toggle are gone. A symbol has no book of its own: routing is the account's group. The stored value is left untouched for now.
- **TRADE MODE** was clipping to *TRADE MOD* → **MODE**; **COMM /LOT** → **COMM/LOT**.

**Price feed — the "connected" chime no longer repeats**
- A dropped price stream retried on a fixed short delay and re-announced *feed live* on every attempt, which on a flapping connection played the connect sound every couple of seconds.
- A connection must now survive 5 s before its backoff resets, so repeated instant failures back off instead of replaying the chime. Shared with the terminal.

---

**Not in this build**

- **Account types (ATY)** is unchanged. Removing the screen was proposed on the basis that `AccountType` was only a second view of the groups API; it is not. It is its own table with its own pricing-override level above the group, and production holds 13 rows with 29 accounts pointing at them. Folding it into Groups needs a migration first, not a screen deletion.
- **Broker onboarding** (starter groups + the 16-symbol set for every new broker) is a **web-side** change and ships with the web deploy. It adds no backoffice UI in this build.
- Publishing a group to clients (`isClientSelectable`) has no control on the Groups screen yet; the column is backfilled so current behaviour is unchanged.

- A dropped price stream retried on a fixed short delay and re-announced *feed live* on every attempt, which on a flapping connection played the connect sound every couple of seconds.
- A connection must now survive 5 s before its backoff resets, so repeated instant failures back off instead of replaying the chime. Shared with the terminal.

---

**Not in this build**

- **Account types (ATY)** is unchanged. Removing the screen was proposed on the basis that `AccountType` was only a second view of the groups API; it is not. It is its own table with its own pricing-override level above the group, and production holds 13 rows with 29 accounts pointing at them. Folding it into Groups needs a migration first, not a screen deletion.
- **Broker onboarding** (starter groups + the 16-symbol set for every new broker) is a **web-side** change and ships with the web deploy. It adds no backoffice UI in this build.
- Publishing a group to clients (`isClientSelectable`) has no control on the Groups screen yet; the column is backfilled so current behaviour is unchanged.

Backoffice 1.0.10

Requires the paired web deploy. The Groups and Dashboard screens read fields (category, modeRestriction, groupCategory, symbolConfigCount) that only exist once the Stage 4 web commits are live, and the Symbols screen stops sending defaultBookType, which the current production route still rejects as missing. Pack after the web is deployed, not before.

Groups — routing and mode are separate things

  • ROUTING replaces the old BOOK column: A-BOOK · LP, B-BOOK, DEALING DESK, plus REVERSAL and COVERAGE · SYS where a group already has one.
  • The routing dropdown offers only the three a broker sets by hand. A group already on REVERSAL (the plugin sets it) or COVERAGE (the system owns it) keeps its value and shows it as (set elsewhere), so opening the form and pressing SAVE can no longer silently re-route it.
  • New MODE column and Accepts field: LIVE + DEMO, LIVE ONLY, DEMO ONLY. Mode was never routing; DEMO is gone from the routing choices.
  • New PRICING column: Source, or Custom (N symbols). Editing stays per symbol in panel 2.
  • The Dealer choices say what they do: DESK-CONTROLLED (queues when the desk is on), NEVER QUEUE (ignores the desk), ALWAYS QUEUE. The panel header shows the broker's live desk state, because that switch — not the group — decides whether a DESK-CONTROLLED group queues.
  • The dead Tier field is gone. The group is the tier.
  • Deleting a group that still holds accounts answers 409 · move its accounts first instead of failing as a server error.

Dashboard — a client's book comes from their group

  • BOOK (declared but always blank) is now CATEGORY, filled from the account's group — the only thing that decides where an order books.
  • New GROUP column beside it.
  • ACT said VIEW FUNDS or VIEW BLOCKED; the row opens Client 360 and never touched funds. It is one verb, OPEN, and status moved to its own STATE tag (SUSP, CLSD), blank for an ordinary active account.
  • ALL STAFF over the activity feed was a chip that looked like a filter and did nothing. Plain text.
  • The approvals queue said no pending withdrawals on a panel that holds deposits too: no pending deposits or withdrawals.
  • LP fill quality reads PENDING · NEEDS LP BRIDGE instead of a measured-looking figure. Nothing has ever been LP-executed.
  • Column headers shortened (CC, LOTS, MGN%) and KYC shown as OK / WAIT / FLAG so the whole table fits at 1366 without clipping.

Symbols — DEFAULT BOOK removed

  • The DEFAULT BOOK column and its click-to-cycle A/B toggle are gone. A symbol has no book of its own: routing is the account's group. The stored value is left untouched for now.
  • TRADE MODE was clipping to TRADE MOD → MODE; COMM /LOT → COMM/LOT.

# Backoffice 1.0.9

**Dealing — client closes in the queue**
- The PENDING QUEUE now carries a **KIND** column: **OPEN**, or **CLOSE #ticket** (amber; **… PART** when the requested lots are less than the position) beside the position's own side.
- **ACCEPT ▾** on a close reads **CLOSE AT** and prices the *at market* option on the close side (a BUY position closes at bid). The row menu is titled CLOSE.
- Rejecting a queued close unlocks the client's position; accepting it closes at the requested or market price with no markup.

Assets.NotesMarkdown:
# Backoffice 1.0.8

**Dealing — the terminal chart, in full**
- The dealing chart is now the trader terminal's own chart, with every function: OHLC header (LAST / CHG / O H L), timeframes 1M–W, the INDICATORS picker (MA, EMA, BOLL, SAR, RSI, MACD, KDJ, ATR, CCI, WR — each with a settings dialog for period / source / colour / width), EMA 20/50 and SESSIONS chips, drawing tools (trend line, horizontal line, ray, rectangle, Fibonacci retracement) with a colour / settings / delete toolbar on the selected drawing, chart settings (candle colours, grid, last-price line, previous-day high/low, session map), zoom / pan / price-scale drag, crosshair with OHLC readout, previous-day high / low, the candle countdown and a right-click menu.
- **Single or 2×2 layout**: four independent charts, each with its own symbol and timeframe picker, a focus border, crosshair sync and double-click to maximise / restore. Layout, cells and timeframes are remembered.
- **The dealer's book on the chart**: the coverage leg is drawn with SL / TP handles; every dealer-managed client position on the symbol is drawn too. Drag a handle or right-click "Set SL / TP here" to modify (confirmed first, wrong side refused on the spot); double-click the coverage leg to close it; double-click a client leg to open its Client 360.
- **One-click widget** with live SELL / BUY prices, a lot box with − / + and a 1-CLICK ON / OFF switch. Order placement waits for the dealer order endpoint: SELL / BUY, limit / stop at a price and price alerts say so rather than doing nothing.
- No indicator is switched on by default — the dealer picks. Studies and drawings persist per symbol and timeframe.
- Chart colours follow the light / dark theme.

**Dealing — market watch, activity, coverage, exposure**
- Market Watch is grouped by category (metals / forex / crypto / indices) in the terminal's style, with bid / ask, spread and day change.
- Dealing Activity shows a closed position's **realized P&L** on its row; the kind column now reads CLOSE / OPEN / PLACED / MODIFY / CANCEL / TRIGGER.
- Coverage Journal has **TRADES / EXPOSURE / HISTORY** views like the dealing-group panel: open coverage legs (closable), per-symbol long / short / net, and closed coverage trades over a date range with the realized total.
- Coverage legs close **manually only** (the ✕ on the row or the chart), with a confirmation; nothing auto-closes.
- The NET strip is a **book exposure summary**: total / covered / open-risk positions and lots, net lots, then dealing-group P&L vs coverage P&L = **dealer net P&L** (the client's P&L is the dealer's opposite side; coverage adds as-is).
- Smart Dealer Manager P&L is coloured and larger.
- Pending queue: ACCEPT offers "at requested price" or "at market"; REQUOTE presets.
- The Dealer Mode panel is terse: one coverage-account row, no explanatory filler.

**General**
- **Single instance**: launching the backoffice again brings the running window to the front instead of opening a second copy.
- Text pass across screens: shorter, consistent labels and messages; panel headers trim their title instead of clipping their controls on narrow screens.
- Closed-position activity is now complete server-side: every close path (stop loss / take profit / stop-out, a trader's close, a manager's close) appears in the feed with its realized P&L.

# Backoffice 1.0.7

**Charts**
- Dealing chart zoom and pan now work (wheel to zoom at the cursor, drag to pan).
- Market Watch prices no longer blink or blank every second — cells update in place.

**Clients**
- Client 360 now shows a **risk score** (surfaced Risk Radar signals: martingale / latency-arb / scalp / shared-IP), the client's **last IP**, a **sessions / devices / IP** login history, and a 90-day **balance curve**.
- **Ledger** is now a table (time / type / amount / reason / status); a row opens the related entity. Tables never truncate — columns fit content and scroll horizontally instead of clipping.
- **Reset password** now emails the new password when the client has one on file, or shows it once when they don't — always with a confirmation.
